Exact square 3x3 grid, nine equal head-and-shoulder portraits of the SAME person, at eye level, head facing straight ahead, complete hair with margin. Thin white gutters. Row1 neutral, slight warm closed smile, happy toothy smile. Row2 surprised raised brows and parted mouth, worried knitted brow, quiet sadness. Row3 annoyed frown, skeptical raised eyebrow, shy affectionate small smile. Nine clearly distinct yet realistic understated expressions, consistent identity and eye color, never reshape the jaw or alter age. No text, labels, extra panels or other people.
